newsitem.title: CHINA: China gold reserves unchanged at 12.67 mln ounces.
newsitem.headline: China gold reserves unchanged at 12.67 mln ounces.

text.p: China's gold reserves were unchanged at 12.67 million ounces at the end of September, the central bank, the People's Bank of China, said in a report published in the Financial News on Thursday.
China produced 108 tonnes of gold in 1995, surpassing 100 tonnes for the first time and ranking it sixth in the world after South Africa, the United States, Australia, Russia and Canada.
